appDesc.message: Search FilmAffinity movies and TV series directly on Trakt.

searchButtonText.description: Text displayed on the search button.

searchButtonAriaLabel.message: Search this title on Trakt.tv in a new tab
searchButtonAriaLabel.description: Accessible label for the search button.

errorMainTitleNotFound.message: Could not find the main title element on the page.

errorGettingTitle.message: Error extracting the title from FilmAffinity.

errorTitleNotFound.description: Error thrown when the title element cannot be found.

errorDeterminingType.message: Error determining whether the page is a TV series.

errorOpeningUrl.description: Error message logged when opening the Trakt URL fails.

errorUrlRequired.message: A valid URL is required to open it.
errorUrlRequired.description: Error thrown when trying to open a null/empty URL.

toastCouldNotGetTitle.message: Could not extract the title from this FilmAffinity page.
toastCouldNotGetTitle.description: Toast message shown to the user when the title cannot be extracted.

toastCouldNotOpenUrl.message: Could not open Trakt.tv. Check your connection or try again.
toastCouldNotOpenUrl.description: Toast message shown to the user when the Trakt URL cannot be opened.

toastCloseLabel.description: Accessible label for the toast dismiss button.
